runs.content: TJX beat its Q3 plan with 4% comps and adjusted EPS of $1.34, raised its FY27 comp guide to 4%, and trades 17% below its 52-week high as an off-price trade-down beneficiary; VLO was trimmed for capacity at −12.15%.

Duke Energy rose 1.1% as utilities and staples were the only sectors up on a 1.9% AI-led S&P fall; Q3 EPS grew 10% with the 2026 guide narrowed to the top end, at ~18x forward earnings and a 3.4% yield, and it is the book's first utility; LOW was trimmed for capacity at −1.94% ahead of its 11-18 report.
